children: First Breach announced its drone prototype reached 161 km/h (100 mph) — the FAA Part 107 groundspeed limit — and that its CRO will present at LD Micro.
Chief Revenue Officer Ken Leith will present First Breach’s business and drone strategy at LD Micro on Oct 20, 2026.
Prototype achieved 161 km/h (100 mph) in flight testing without payload — the maximum groundspeed allowed under FAA Part 107.
Company is pursuing FAA waivers to test above 100 mph to characterize full speed envelope.
Targets initial prototype completion in Q4 2026 and scaled production start in Q2 2027 with capacity over 2,500 drones/week.
